digest.component_or_area: completion verification gate / LLM agent loop detection
propositions: The runaway guard sits outermost in the layer composition and counts memo-served (cached, zero-cost) repeats as loop evidence before the memo layer answers them, causing legitimate re-reads of memoized evidence files to trigger RunawayToolLoopError.
Memo-served cache hits should not increment the distinct-ratio window used by the runaway guard; only calls that reach wrapped tools should count as loop evidence.

The guard and memo layers need a shared ToolCallLedger to track executed vs observed calls, with the memo layer calling record_executed only on paths that actually reach tools (5 sites: non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-signature miss, read_file path-None passthrough, read_file first-read fetch, truncated-window exact-range fallback).
A pure cache-served loop (zero execution for a full window) must still be bounded via a served-streak backstop, while memo-served repeats no longer trip the distinct-ratio arm.
Verifier runs that re-read memoized evidence files must complete without RunawayToolLoopError while genuine loops (non-allowlisted repeats, error-looping tools, cache-served spins) remain bounded.
